packages.label: אֱמוּנָה וּתְפִלָּה
packages.reason: All these concepts share the same essential nature: the domain of faith, prayer, and miracles that transcend nature. The Torah opens by equating emunah, tefilla, and nisim as a single reality. Circles (egulim) express emunah's encompassing quality; isha is the receptive emunah; ish/emet are its masculine counterpart; Yaakov u-vanav are the 12 nuschaot of prayer; tehomot upper and lower are the two registers of miracles; prita sifvateih is the angel of prayer. All are faces of the same transcendent, supra-natural dimension.
merge_notes: יעקב ובניו / שנים עשר נסחאות התפלה: merged in because יעקב ובניו is explicitly בחינת תפלה in the text (s.1) — 2-node component absorbed into the tefilla cluster.
איש / אמת: merged in because the text explicitly equates אשה=אמונה and איש=אמת as one pair ('הִתְחַבְּרוּת אֱמֶת וֶאֱמוּנָה'); אשה is already in this package.
ישמעאל: merged in via edge 3184 (ישמעאל — תפלה, reference 7, bechina). Yishmael's name encodes 'God heard my prayer' and the Targum renders this explicitly as tefilla.
This package is the Torah's primary positive teaching about the supra-natural dimension of faith, prayer, and redemption.

packages.label: יוֹסֵף וְצִיצִית
packages.reason: These concepts share the nature of shmirat ha-brit — the guarding of the covenant of holiness. Yosef is the archetype of shmirat ha-brit; tzitzit is its practical expression (covering/protecting against sexual impurity); shekhem is the body location of tzitzit (shoulders); 'v'eleh' (the additive word) is its exegetical marker. The group forms the domain of holy guarding that enables receiving emet from tzaddikim.
merge_notes: Note: edges 1290 and 3222 are both יוסף—תקון הברית (duplicate bechina stating the same equivalence); counted as 1 unique connection for degree purposes.
Tzitzit is the practical guardian against the serpent's counsel — it enables passage from this package to the eitza package (counsel from tzaddikim).

packages.label: עֵצָה וְנִשּׂוּאִין
packages.label_en: Counsel and Marriage — the Holy Side
packages.reason: These concepts share the nature of holy counsel: the metaphysical structure whereby receiving advice from a tzaddik is like receiving seed (zera emet). Har Sinai is the prototype of holy counsel (613 eitin); the shureq vowel = 3 drops = 3 brains, embodying how the tzaddik's sekhel flows into the receiver through counsel. All are expressions of the same receptive, intellectual-generative structure of holy advice.
merge_notes: שורק / תלת טפין / תלת מחין: 3-node component merged into the counsel package because the shureq appears explicitly in the context of receiving the tzaddik's intellectual drops (tipei ha-sekhel) through counsel — same essential nature as the advice-as-seed metaphor.

נשואין serves as the pivot node between the good and evil counsel packages (Package 4). The node 'נשואין' is shared in nature — advice has a marriage-structure regardless of whether it is holy or impure.

packages.label: עֲצַת הַנָּחָשׁ
packages.reason: These concepts share the nature of impure counsel: receiving advice from the wicked is structurally a marriage with the klipa — it implants spiritual impurity (zuhama). The serpent's counsel to Eve is the prototype; 'nisuin ba-klipa' and niuf are its downstream expressions. This is the direct evil mirror of Package 3.
merge_notes: This is the evil mirror of Package 3 (Counsel and Marriage). The node נשואין appears in Package 3; נשואין בקלפה is its impure counterpart — a separate node representing the same structural reality oriented toward evil.
מנשואין של רשע connects to נאוף — the direct manifestation of evil counsel in sexual misconduct.

packages.label: שִׁכְחָה
packages.reason: מס (the letter-pair mem-samekh) and שכחה (forgetting) share the same essential nature: they are both expressions of the force that covers and negates the renewal that emunah embodies. The appendix explicitly says: 'מס הוא בחינת השכחה' and that nes (miracle) is the opposite of shikcha — because miracles embody emunah's perception of constant renewal, while forgetting embodies the naturalistic/astrological mindset that is the opposite of emunah. This 2-node component is preserved as its own package because it forms the explicit evil mirror of Package 1 (Emunah).
merge_notes: 2-node component retained as a separate evil package rather than merged into Package 1 because it represents a distinct evil domain (the anti-emunah force of forgetting/naturalism) that mirrors Package 1's positive content.
Would merge into Package 1 only if a polarity-neutral approach were taken, but the teaching's structure makes this a standalone evil counterpart.
